text:
incident-bot: 🔔 INCIDENT (P2) — metering emitter irregularity detected. Token counts diverging between emitter and ledger since ~2026-03-15T02:12Z. Paging @sre-oncall and @billing-eng. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1765439999

sre-oncall: ack — joining. what's the initial diff?

billing-eng: seeing emitter > ledger by ~7-9% for a subset of windows starting 02:12UTC. Counts spike on emitter side around shard em-7. Query: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM emitter WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-15T02:00' AND '2026-03-15T03:00'` vs ledger totals.

support-lead: two customers have already hit automated overage flags and got emails (acct: acme-co, beta-ops). CS is collecting details.

ops-lead: which deploy changed recently on emitter? any recent config toggles?

ml-infra: recent deploy rwm-emitter canary at 02:05UTC — image: rwm-emitter:2026-03-15-5f3. Rolling back for canary failed earlier due to pod crashloop.

billing-eng: logs show retry loops in emitter when upstream ack lag > 500ms — some retries didn't dedupe due to missing idempotency header `X-emit-id`. Suspect duplicate emits. Example log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:14:11Z em-7 INFO emit sent chunk_id=abc123 retries=2
2026-03-15T02:14:11Z em-7 WARN ack_timeout chunk_id=abc123
2026-03-15T02:14:14Z em-7 INFO emit sent chunk_id=abc123 retries=3
```

customer-success: ACME confirmed they saw an overage email at 02:30UTC and opened a ticket. They're requesting confirmation it's a false-positive.

sre-oncall: temp mitigation: 1) mute billing alarm for emitter token-diff for 30m 2) put traffic to emitter-stable variant em-std-1 3) block automated overage emails for accounts flagged in last hour (suppress template `billing.overage.v2`).

ops-lead: I'll divert traffic to em-std-1 now. Command used: `kubectl set image deploy/emitter emitter=image:rwm-emitter-stable --namespace=prod`

ml-infra: divert done. New pods healthy. sending a quick smoke: `curl -sS https://em-std-1.prod/health` => OK.

billing-eng: started a dry-run reprocess for 02:00-03:00 window to compute corrected ledger totals: `python scripts/reprocess_window.py --start 2026-03-15T02:00 --end 2026-03-15T03:00 --dry-run`

support-lead: paused sending additional overage flags; CS replied to ACME explaining we're investigating and will adjust billing if needed.

incident-bot: NOTE: alert suppression created (alert: metering.token-diff) by @sre-oncall for 30m.

billing-eng: dry-run indicates about 8.2% of emitted tokens in that window would be removed after dedupe — matches the divergence. Reprocess will correct ledger but downstream re-emit of corrected totals required for customer dashboards.

ml-infra: root cause: recent emitter change removed `X-emit-id` in a high-latency path; retries were not being deduped by the ledger side. Patch merged: add header back + idempotency check (PR #4281). Rolling patch to canary now.

sre-oncall: what's ETA for full rollback vs patch?

ml-infra: canary patch deploy started at 02:48UTC. If healthy for 10m we can rollout to stable. Alternatively ops can force rollback to pre-5f3 image.

ops-lead: opting for rollback to stable image (safer). Rolling back to rwm-emitter:2026-02-28-9d2. Rolling update kicked.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollback started (deploy/emitter). See: https://k8s.redwood/deploys/rollback/1765439999

billing-eng: reprocess started in earnest (non-dry-run). Estimate reprocess + re-emit of corrected metering events for the 02:00-03:00 blocks: ~45min. Queue length ~120k chunks.

support-lead: CS updated ACME and Beta Ops with ETA ~45m and offered to credit any overage charges pending final reconciliation.

customer-success: ACME acknowledged and said they'd hold off on billing escalation. Thanks.

ml-infra: rollback to stable finished, emitter pods back to pre-canary image at 03:05UTC. Monitoring shows emitter vs ledger diff trending to <0.5% after reprocess started.

sre-oncall: monitoring: token-diff alert cleared for all shards. Leaving suppression for a bit longer; will remove in 20m if stable.

billing-eng: reprocess completed at 03:40UTC; re-emit finished at 03:48UTC. Overages rescinded where applicable; billing ledger reconciled.

support-lead: sent final customer notes to affected accounts, confirmed credits applied where appropriate.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: metering emitter duplicate-emits causing token-count drift. Root cause: missing idempotency header in retry path introduced in canary. Actions: rollback to stable, patch PR #4281 to add header, reprocess window, suppress false overage emails during mitigation. Postmortem requested.

ops-lead: thanks team — please add runbook entry to `docs/runbooks/metering-emitter.md` for future emitter retries/idempotency checks.

billing-eng: will follow up with postmortem and list of affected accounts (~28) + reconciliation csv.

sre-oncall: closing thread when postmortem link is up. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
